paragraphs: R' Hananiah ben Akavyah. See the entry R' Hanina ben Akiva.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has חנניה בן עקביה, Hananiah ben Akavyah, and the target חנינא בן עקיבא, Hanina ben Akiva. The two forms remain distinct without deciding that either is an error. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
